instruction.text: Schaue dir das Bild an. Welche Aussage passt am besten zum Bild?
Wie könnten sich die Personen auf den Bildern fühlen? Wähle das jeweils passende Adjektiv aus.

atoms.b: It makes me ((++angry proud)) to see that people leave their plastic waste on the beach.
I feel ((++excited disappointed)) to hear that we will have a new classmate next year.
I find it ((++fulfilling strange)) to do volunteer work.
It is ((++annoying inspiring)) that we will have three exams next week.

instruction.text: Welches Bild wird beschrieben? Wähle das jeweils passende Bild aus.

atoms.a: I would call the boy's behaviour in the picture normal, because disagreements with parents can happen.
The friend group's situation seems thrilling because they ride a rollercoaster.
It is understandable to feel sorrow when your best friend is moving to a different city.
I consider it brave to stand up against violence.

instruction.text: Ordne die Sätze den jeweils passenden Gefühlslagen zu.

atoms.b: I'm on top of the world.
